clips.start_words: It's a story about a kid
clips.send: A friend sends this to someone making excuses about why this year hasn't been their year - real awe, the blunt proof that excuses don't matter.
clips.caption:
There's an old book called The Go-Getter, about a kid given an impossible task: find one specific blue vase that was never meant to be found. He delivers it anyway.

Kevin Trudeau says Zig Ziglar told him the real version of that story: Ziglar's brother Judge won a sales championship one year. What he never mentioned on stage was that same year he lost a close relative, broke his toe, and couldn't afford to fix his car.

A winner doesn't wait for a year with no obstacles. They decide first, then change the route when life gets in the way.

What obstacle have you been using as your excuse this year?

#kevintrudeau #success #mindset #motivation #wealthmindset #selfimprovement

clips.send: A friend sends this to someone who feels stuck in a dead-end job - the fastest real proof that timelines can break, real awe.
clips.caption:
Before he was a movie star, Bruce Lee was washing dishes to get by.

Kevin Trudeau says Bruce Lee read the book Think and Grow Rich and did exactly what Napoleon Hill said: define the dream in writing, build a burning desire for it, and feel now as if it's already yours.

In about eighteen months, he went from washing pots and pans to one of the highest-paid actors in movies.

Same book, same formula, sitting on a shelf somewhere near you right now.

#kevintrudeau #success #mindset #wealthmindset #motivation #money

clips.start_words: You have two ears and one mouth
clips.end_words: tell me everything you don't know
clips.send: Someone forwards this to a friend who never stops talking about their own problems - the blunt wake-up, real anger at being tuned out.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's rule for people skills: you have two ears and one mouth. Use them in that proportion.

He says most people do the opposite - talking for twenty minutes about their own problems and never asking the other person a question.

Then he makes it personal: you're driving a thirty-five-year-old car held together with hope, and the guy across from you is driving a Rolls-Royce. If you want to learn about money, ask him a question instead of telling your life story.

Who in your life actually has the results you want, and when did you last ask them anything?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #success #wealthmindset #motivation #selfimprovement
